subject: POC MAP: Org bootstrap & API key lifecycle for QuantifyHealth trial
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@quantifyhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Oct 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC MAP items and network details we need

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looks promising for our triage workflows. Procurement asked me to send a concise mutual action plan so we can line up both sides for the trial. At a minimum we need:

- Org setup: Redwood tenant + one service account for our engineering team.
- API tokens: short-lived token for the POC (we prefer ephemeral tokens with 30d expiry for the trial).
- IP allowlist: our firewall team will provide CIDR ranges; we need the exact egress IPs to allow.
- VPC peering: confirm VPC peer requirements (shared VPC vs managed peering) and route table expectations.

Attaching our draft SOW for context (Quantify_SOW_v2.pdf). Can you propose a minimal timeline and who from your side owns each item? We are aiming to kick the POC week of Oct 21 if possible.

Sara
Sara Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations
QuantifyHealth

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@quantifyhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Oct 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP items and network details we need

Hi Sara — thanks for the SOW and the clear ask. I drafted a compact mutual action plan and assignment of owners; attaching the MAP template (redwood_map_template.xlsx). High level proposal below — feasible to start week of Oct 21 if your teams can confirm firewall CIDRs by Oct 18.

MAP summary (proposed):
- Org + IAM: Redwood sets tenant and creates an organization-level service account (owner: Michael Grant). Deliverable: org-id and service-account-email. ETA: Oct 18.
- API tokens: we will issue an ephemeral token scoped to the POC service account. Token lifecycle: 30-day TTL, single-use rotation recommended. (owner: Rishi Malhotra). ETA: Oct 19.
- IP allowlist: Redwood will provide the egress CIDR(s) and proxy IPs. You provide inbound CIDRs to add to our allowlist if required. (owner: Priyom Das). ETA: Oct 18.
- VPC peering: Technical kickoff to validate subnet CIDRs and BGP/static routes. We support managed peer (Redwood-managed VPC) or cross-account peering via your cloud team; route table directions required either way. (owner: Priyom Das). ETA: initial tech call by Oct 15.

Open items for QuantifyHealth to confirm:
- Preferred token expiry (you requested 30d; confirm acceptance of rotating token approach).
- VPC peering model (managed vs customer-hosted peer).
- A primary Slack channel or Pager for pre-launch escalations.

Next steps: If Oct 15 tech call works, Priyom will send a calendar invite with an agenda (subnets, CIDRs, security groups, expected egress). I can also provide an Ops checklist to hand to your cloud engineer.

Regards,
Michael
Michael Grant
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@quantifyhealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Oct 2029 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP items and network details we need

Sara / Michael — looping in a few technical details to prepare for the Oct 15 call:

1) For VPC peering we need:
   - Destination VPC CIDR(s) (no overlap with our worker subnets).
   - List of subnets that will receive traffic (app vs mgmt).
   - Whether you require asymmetric SNAT on egress.
2) Route tables: if you host the peer, ensure routes to Redwood worker CIDRs are propagated to the subnets. If Redwood manages the peer, we will provide a short list of accepted routes and next-hop.

Also: if you prefer ephemeral API keys, we support short-lived JWT tokens exchanged via an OAuth-like flow; otherwise we can provide scoped API keys bound to a service account. Please confirm which pattern your platform prefers so I can prepare the key exchange demo.

I'll include a short runbook during the call.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@quantifyhealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: QuantifyHealth Procurement <procurement@quantifyhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Oct 2029 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP items and network details we need

Thanks — quick answers from our side:

- Token expiry: 30d ephemeral tokens are fine for the POC. We will rotate monthly and have an automation runbook.
- VPC peering: our infra team prefers to host the peer in our account (customer-hosted). They will add routes and accept your worker CIDRs.
- Firewall CIDRs: attached (QH_firewall_ranges.csv). Primary egress blocks are 198.51.100.0/22 and 203.0.113.0/24.
- Tech call: Oct 15 is a touch early for us; can we do Oct 17 at 10:00 PT instead? Procurement will need the SOW signature to complete billing setup — procurement@quantifyhealth.com is copied.

On procurement: they will want a short list of what evidence we will receive (audit logs, model version, retention policy) during the trial. Can you add that to the MAP template?

Best,
Sara

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@quantifyhealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, QuantifyHealth Procurement <procurement@quantifyhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Oct 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC MAP items and network details we need

On Thu, Oct 10, 2029 at 9:12 AM Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@quantifyhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile looks promising for our triage workflows.
> Procurement asked me to send a concise mutual action plan so we can line up both sides for the trial.

Sara / team — confirmed for Oct 17 at 10:00 PT; calendar invite sent (please accept). Summary of agreed next steps and owners below:

- Oct 17 tech call (10:00 PT): Priyom to validate CIDRs and VPC peering model; expected attendees: quantify infra lead, Priyom, Rishi.
- Oct 18: Redwood provides org-id, service-account-email, and egress IP list (owner: Michael).
- Oct 19: Ephemeral token issued to QuantifyHealth service account (owner: Rishi). Token TTL: 30 days; we will provide rotation guidance.
- Oct 21: POC test traffic window opens; Redwood will monitor and provide token usage logs and model version metadata for the trial.
- Procurement evidence: we will include limited audit logs (token issuance and call counts), model version string in responses, and a short retention policy statement in the MAP template.

Attachments uploaded to the MAP folder (link above). Priyom — please save the runbook snippet to the shared Drive prior to the call.

If procurement needs a PO or billing contact, Michael: I will follow up offline to provide finance contact info.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting you live.

Michael
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
